description: This file defines the StudioModule class which is part of the ModuleBuilder component in SuiteCRM. It manages module metadata such as views, fields, relationships, subpanels, and layouts. It also provides methods for retrieving module information, checking module types, and manipulating layout metadata.

classes.name: StudioModule
classes.description: Represents a module in the SuiteCRM Module Builder, providing access to its metadata such as fields, views, relationships, layouts, and subpanels, and methods to manipulate these components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StudioModule object, setting module name, fields, and source definitions based on the provided module name.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the standardized name of the module, handling special naming conventions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Attempts to determine the module's type, e.g., 'basic', 'company', 'issue', by examining inheritance and predefined mappings.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the field definitions of the module.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns a tree data structure representing the module with its name, module, type, icon, and children.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about different views and components of the module such as labels, fields, relationships, layouts, and subpanels.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Returns an array of view definitions that exist for this module, looking into metadata directories.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Returns layout definitions, including special layouts like QuickCreate, Dashlets, Popups, and search views.

methods.name: isValidDashletModule
methods.description: Checks if a dashlet exists for this module.

methods.name: getSearch
methods.description: Returns search view configurations for the module.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Returns a set of relationships involving this module.

methods.name: getSubpanels
methods.description: Retrieves subpanel configurations for this module.

methods.name: getProvidedSubpanels
methods.description: Retrieves subpanels provided by this module for other modules.

methods.name: getParentModulesOfSubpanel
methods.description: Returns modules that include the specified subpanel.

methods.name: removeFieldFromLayouts
methods.description: Removes a specified field from all layouts, search configurations, and subpanel definitions.

methods.name: getViewMetadataSources
methods.description: Returns sources of view metadata for the module.

methods.name: getViewType
methods.description: Determines the type of view based on the source.
